output.scope_note: The paper studies concentrated aqueous ammonium acetate solutions (water-in-salt electrolytes), which are liquid electrolytes, not solid Li/Na-ion conductors; the conductivity numbers it quotes (LP30, TEABF4/ACN, ionic liquids, LiTFSI and NaClO4 WiSE, Li/K acetate WiSE) are for liquids, and its own conductivity results are shown only as Arrhenius plots in a figure.
